Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Diagnosed with type 2 diabetes ([a] two verifiable FBS test results of 140 mg/dl or above or [b] taking or have taken insulin or hypoglycemic agents for at least one year in the past)
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has type 2 diabetes managed with metformin, with HbA1c levels between 6.5% and 7.2% (consistent with diabetes) and no mention of FBS tests being unverified, so [b] is satisfied.
Written informed consent has been obtained from the patient or their legal representative.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: A family member, preferably a spouse or first-degree relative, who agrees to participate
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient's family history includes a paternal father with cardiovascular risk, but no specific family member (spouse or first-degree relative) is stated to agree to participate.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Migrant farm workers (not available for the year-long program)
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is not described as a migrant farm worker.
Patient is male and not pregnant.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Medical conditions for which changes in diet and exercise levels would be contraindicated
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has hypercholesterolemia and mild hepatic transaminases, but no explicit statement confirms diet/exercise changes are contraindicated.

Recap: Patient meets diabetes and consent criteria but lacks clear family member participation. No explicit contraindications to diet/exercise changes, but family member involvement is unclear.
